# SJH Fulfilment

SJH Fulfilment is a Warehousing company. SJH Fulfilment employs 5 people, founded in 2016. Headquartered in Kilkeel, Northern Ireland, United Kingdom.

## About

We are an order fulfilment (or e-fulfilment) company based in Northern Ireland offering receiving, warehousing, picking, packing and delivery solutions.

Our software connects to your e-commerce platforms and in real time sends us your orders, allowing us to pick, pack and ship your orders without the need for you to lift a box or open your laptop.

# SJH, Inc. - Sino-Japan Heaters

SJH, Inc. - Sino-Japan Heaters is a Appliances, Electrical, and Electronics Manufacturing company. SJH Electric Heating Solutions is a trusted provider of quality heating solutions worldwide. They offer tubular heaters, flexible heaters, and more. They have service centers, manufacturing sites, and custom solutions. They prioritize reliability and excellent service. SJH, Inc. - Sino-Japan Heaters employs 86 people (-1.1% YoY, -1 person), founded in 1965. Headquartered in Chula Vista, California, United States, operates in 7 countries (including China, Japan, Mexico, Taiwan, and Malaysia). Its workforce is distributed across 5 countries (including United States, Mexico, China, India, and Malaysia).

## About

SJH Inc is one of the world's largest producers of electric heating elements. We been committed to producing first-class heating solutions of the highest standard for more than 50 years. Supplying heating solutions to customers all over the world across multiple industries. With a new manufacturing facility in Mexico and 3 manufacturing facilities in China, we are ready to meet global demands.

SJH strives to increase our range of products to cover all types of heater constructions. If a new kind of heater is needed, the SJH R&D department will endeavor to come up with a solution. Some of the different products SJH produces are:

Sheath Heaters
Cartridge Heaters
Flat-bar Heaters
Silicone Flexible Heaters
Thermocouples
Open Coil Heaters
Thick Film Heaters
Foil Heaters
Gravity-cast Heaters
Die-cast Heaters
Finned Heaters
Deep Drawn Products
Metal Tubing
Metal Stamped Components
High-Frequency Welded Products
